title: Trace explorer v2 right pane: wrap user-facing labels in FormattedMessage and regenerate en.json, not hardcode English
answers: Span link tab shows English text that does not translate, how do I localize it?
Where are the span link Jump to linked span, Trace ID, Span ID and See more labels defined?
How do I add a new user-facing string to the redesigned trace explorer (v2) so it is extracted into the message catalog?
Why do the trace explorer tooltips use intl.formatMessage while the labels use FormattedMessage?
body:
Path: Right-pane tabs of the redesigned (v2) trace explorer, which render a selected span's links, attributes and events. The span link UI goes through mlflow/server/js/src/shared/web-shared/model-trace-explorer/v2/right-pane/ModelTraceExplorerLinksTab.tsx:SpanLinkEntry, which renders the Jump to linked span button, Trace ID / Span ID / Linked span labels, the Attributes section and the See more / See less toggle.
Rule: Every user-facing string in these components is wrapped in a FormattedMessage (imported from '@databricks/i18n') with a defaultMessage and a description, or passed through intl.formatMessage for attributes such as tooltips. Sibling tabs such as ModelTraceExplorerAttributesTab and ModelTraceExplorerEventsTab already follow this. After adding or changing a string, run `yarn i18n` to regenerate mlflow/server/js/src/lang/default/en.json and then `yarn i18n:check`; do not hand-write the catalog entries.
Constraints: Applies to visible labels and tooltips in the v2 trace explorer. Two-state text such as See more / See less needs a separate FormattedMessage per branch, each with its own description. Unit tests that query by rendered text keep working under an IntlProvider with locale="en", so existing tests should not need changes just because strings were wrapped.
applies: Any edit to user-facing text in the redesigned (v2) trace explorer right-pane components under model-trace-explorer/v2 in the MLflow OSS frontend.
says: Trace explorer side panel displays English text instead of the selected language
Span link details in the trace view do not translate into other languages
Jump to linked span button and span identifier labels appear only in English
The see more toggle in trace span details remains untranslated after language switch
Localize all labels and tooltips in the redesigned trace explorer side drawer
search: User-facing labels and tooltips in redesigned v2 trace explorer right-pane components under model-trace-explorer/v2 must use FormattedMessage from @databricks/i18n with defaultMessage and description, or intl.formatMessage for attributes. After modifying strings, run yarn i18n to regenerate mlflow/server/js/src/lang/default/en.json and check with yarn i18n:check instead of manually editing catalog files. Two-state text like See more and See less requires a separate FormattedMessage per branch. This applies to ModelTraceExplorerLinksTab.tsx:SpanLinkEntry, ModelTraceExplorerAttributesTab, and ModelTraceExplorerEventsTab.
